$comment: Standalone SSH tool backend for Aide. This is not Gondolin. Copy to .pi/ssh.json, set host, then start with bin/aide (sets PI_AIDE_SSH=1 and PI_AIDE_SSH_HOST). Leave identityFile empty to scan ~/.ssh keys. Empty host with SSH on fails the tools. This does not copy files. Share the tree with NFS. Do not put passwords or private keys in this file.
